description: Unofficial companion for Bun in VS Code: every script one click away, monorepo workspaces and catalogs understood, package.json mistakes caught as you type. Zero config.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Packages and navigation work in Restricted Mode; running scripts requires a trusted workspace.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: Bun Companion reads package.json files from disk and runs the bun executable.
viewContainer.title: Bun
taskDefinition.package: Package directory relative to the project root, or a package name. Empty for the root package.
taskDefinition.filter: bun run --filter selectors, run from the project root (e.g. "web...").
config.bunPath: Path to the `bun` executable. Leave empty to detect it automatically (setting, `bun.runtime` of the official Bun extension, `PATH`, `$BUN_INSTALL`, `~/.bun/bin`, Homebrew).
config.style: How packages are laid out in the Packages view.
config.style.auto: A flat list for up to 10 packages, folders above that.
config.followActiveEditor: Select the package of the active editor in the Packages view.
config.scriptClickAction: What clicking a script in the Packages view does.
config.statusBar: Show the active file's package in the status bar.
config.diagnostics: Report broken workspace: and catalog: references in package.json files.
config.commandsHidden: Commands to hide from the Command Palette, the Packages view and context menus. They keep working from keybindings and `tasks.json`.
